It's pretty sad that a city that considers itself the greatest in the world needs to turn AC up to 78 just so the power grid won't collapse. Why can't NYC build a better power grid?


Mayor Zohran Kwame Mamdani (@NYCMayor)

New York: it's hot out there, and the power grid is working overtime to keep us cool.

Set your AC to 78 degrees, turn off lights/electronics you're not using, and unplug what you can.

posts.text:
As someone who has written many times about how we need national health insurance, I can say this just isn't true. Almost all Americans have health insurance, and the quality of our care is very high. It costs too much, but most of the cost is not out-of-pocket.


Anthony LaMesa (@ajlamesa)

Centrist Democrats upset by the DSA victories need to accept some responsibility. We’re 50 to 80 years behind other rich countries on universal health care and you guys still treat national health insurance
posts.summary: Defends U.S. healthcare quality despite high costs
